subject: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & term uplift for Globex
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@globex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & term uplift for Globex

Hi Sandra —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We want to make the renewal smooth and align the onboarding evidence to Globex's procurement portal so finance can process the updated term (24-month) and a 25% capacity uplift before July 1. Quick points/action items from our side: 

- Attached: updated SOW draft (Globex-SOW-v2.pdf) with the uplift and term language.
- We need the procurement portal to accept our new vendor form and the SOW reference ID so your AP team can issue a PO.
- Is there a specific evidence bundle (SOC 2 snapshot, IP/ISV forms) that must be uploaded to the portal versus emailed?

Can you confirm the primary procurement contact and whether DocuSign routing is acceptable for signature? If it helps, Laura and Chloe can handle the portal upload and evidence package.

I'll loop Ben from Sales for pricing confirmation once we have the PO cadence.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Globex-SOW-v2.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)
From: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@globex.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephen Park <stephen.park@globexprocure.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & term uplift for Globex

Vivek —

Appreciate the SOW. High level: Globex procurement is OK with the 24-month term and the capacity uplift, subject to a standard PO and evidence upload. A few items from our side: 

- Primary procurement contact: Stephen Park (copied). He manages our vendor portal intake.
- Evidence: SOC 2 report (most recent), CA/ISO attestation, and a one-page data handling summary must be uploaded into the portal. We prefer portal upload for traceability; email is acceptable for larger PDFs but portal links must exist.
- DocuSign: acceptable; please include Globex procurement in the signing order.

Stephen — can you confirm if there are any new vendor re-onboarding fields this year that Redwood needs to complete? Also send the portal intake URL and any required template IDs.

Thanks,
Sandra Wu
VP, Procurement Operations
Globex Corporation

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & term uplift for Globex

Looping in internal ops and legal touchpoints. Draft mutual action plan below — please review and I'll turn this into a checklist in our shared Drive.

MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (high level)
- Today (Jun 22): Redwood sends final SOW + DocuSign envelope. (Vivek + Ben)
- Jun 22–23: Redwood ops (Chloe) uploads SOC 2 snapshot, data handling summary, and CA attestation to Globex portal. (Chloe)
- Jun 23: Globex procurement validates portal evidence and returns template PO number. (Stephen)
- Jun 24: Signatures complete and PO issued; Redwood accepts updated term. (All)

Attachments to upload (we'll attach as stubs here):
- SOC2-2027-snapshot.pdf
- Data-Handling-Redwood-1p.pdf

Notes / asks for Chloe:
- Use the portal intake ID Stephen provides; include SOW reference GX-2027-RNW-42 in the portal comment field.
- Take screenshots of the portal receipt and paste into the Drive runbook (procure_portal_screenshot.png).

Ben — pricing confirmation: the uplift is charged based on the committed monthly token units in the SOW; we agreed on the 6% step-up discount for a 24-month commit. Please confirm pricing paragraph is locked before the DocuSign send.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Data-Handling-Redwood-1p.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)
Attachment: SOC2-2027-snapshot.pdf (PDF, 310 KB)

Subject: Redwood vendor re-onboarding: evidence upload & expedited review (SOW GX-2027-RNW-42)

Hi Stephen / Portal team —

Chloe here from Redwood ops. We're completing a re-onboarding for Globex (SOW ref GX-2027-RNW-42) and need to upload the following artifacts into your portal intake:

- SOC2-2027-snapshot.pdf
- Data-Handling-Redwood-1p.pdf
- Globex-SOW-v2.pdf (SOW reference only — final SOW will be routed via DocuSign)

Could you confirm the intake ID and whether any additional vendor fields (banking/ACH, tax form, subproc policies) are now required for re-onboarding? We're requesting an expedited review to meet a PO issuance on Jun 24.

Chloe / Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the submission. Intake ID: GLOBEX-INT-9017. Evidence uploaded and validated for portal traceability. No new mandatory vendor banking fields required for re-onboarding — tax/ACH will be collected at PO stage if needed.

I have created a procurement ticket and assigned PO# GX-PO-7784. DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/Envelopes/123456789abcdef) has been prepopulated and routed to Globex procurement for signature. Expect PO issuance by end of day Jun 24 if signatures complete.

If anything blocks the DocuSign routing, reply here and we'll escalate.

Best,
Stephen Park
